description: This file contains an abstract test class for verifying multiple grain directory implementations across cluster silos in an Orleans-based distributed system. It includes test methods for pinging grains, managing silo states, and retrieving grain instances on primary and secondary silos.

classes.name: MultipleGrainDirectoriesTests
classes.description: An abstract base class for testing multiple grain directory implementations across cluster silos in Orleans.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Configures the test cluster with a specified number of silos.

methods.name: PingGrain
methods.description: Performs a ping test between grains on primary and secondary silos, verifies silo communication, and tests silo shutdown behavior.

methods.name: GetGrainOnPrimary
methods.description: Retrieves a grain instance from the primary silo based on runtime instance ID.

methods.name: GetGrainOnSecondary
methods.description: Retrieves a grain instance from the secondary silo based on runtime instance ID.
